name: fitai
description: FitAI - Gym AI Tracker with ML Service

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend & npm run dev:ml
scripts.dev:ml: cd ml-service && pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
